avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce protein degradation pathways and potentially reduce carfilzomib efficacy through competing proteasome modulation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult oncology team before initiating

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate bleeding risk and increase peripheral neuropathy risk when combined with carfilzomib
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin E supplementation; discuss with prescriber

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet effects may compound carfilzomib-associated thrombotic and bleeding complications
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor platelet counts closely if unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild proteasome-modulating properties; theoretical additive effects on proteasome inhibition
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; consider lower doses

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects may slightly increase bleeding risk in susceptible patients
caution_supplements.action: Use standard doses; monitor for unusual bruising or bleeding

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: May inhibit minor metabolic pathways and increase carfilzomib exposure; potential for enhanced toxicity
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit and juice; consider alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Carfilzomib can cause hypertension; excess sodium may exacerbate this effect
caution_foods.action: Moderate sodium intake; monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-rich beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase heart rate and blood pressure in patients with carfilzomib-induced cardiovascular effects
caution_foods.action: Limit caffeine intake; monitor for palpitations or hypertension

monitoring_notes: Carfilzomib has minimal CYP450 metabolism, reducing traditional drug-supplement interactions, but close monitoring for bleeding, thrombosis, peripheral neuropathy, and cardiovascular effects is essential. Regular blood pressure, platelet count, and cardiac function assessments should be maintained throughout therapy.
